summary: Implemented native cart template, ACF cart fields/SVG, importer configuration, QA preparation, and commerce reconciliation. Build completed. Visual QA cannot capture the cart state because the host skips preparation for this state-less route.
issues: Page-only QA is 20.491% and has absent cart section geometry because it opens an anonymous empty cart.
visual.js invokes qa-state.prepare only for routes with a state; cart has no manifest state, so the real Aquatos/coupon preparation is skipped.
